From Wiktionary, the free dictionary

Italian

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • trar (apocopic)
  • traere, traggere (obsolete)

Etymology

[edit]

Inherited from Early Medieval Latin tragere, from Latin trahere.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈtrar.re/[1]
  • Rhymes: -arre
  • Hyphenation: tràr‧re

Verb

[edit]

tràrre (first-person singular present tràggo, first-person singular past historic tràssi, past participle tràtto, first-person singular imperfect traévo, auxiliary avére)

  1. (transitive) to draw, extract, pull
  2. (transitive) to elicit, generalise/generalize
  3. (transitive) to derive
